texts.title: Text A: Oakdale Fitness Club, Membership Options

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
STANDARD MEMBERSHIP: £38 per month. Unlimited use of the gym, the swimming pool and the sauna, seven days a week from 6.00 am to 10.00 pm. Includes one free personal training session in your first month.

OFF-PEAK MEMBERSHIP: £26 per month. Use of all facilities Monday to Friday between 10.00 am and 4.00 pm only. A good choice for shift workers and retired people.

STUDENT MEMBERSHIP: £22 per month. Same access as standard membership. Proof of full-time study is required.

JOINING: There is a joining fee of £20, which is waived if you sign up during the first week of January. All members must attend a compulsory 30-minute induction, which can be booked at the front desk.

CANCELLATION: You may cancel at any time by giving two weeks' notice in writing. Memberships can be frozen for up to three months if you are ill or travelling, but evidence is required.

GUESTS: Each member may bring one guest per month free of charge. Further visits cost £8 per guest.

texts.title: Text B: Swimming Pool Timetable, Oakdale Leisure Centre

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text:
LANE SWIMMING: Monday to Friday, 6.30 am to 8.30 am and 12.00 noon to 2.00 pm. Three lanes are reserved for fast swimmers, two for medium and one for slow. Please choose the lane that suits your speed.

FAMILY SESSIONS: Saturdays and Sundays, 10.00 am to 12.00 noon. Children under eight must be accompanied in the water by an adult. Inflatable toys are allowed during this session only.

ADULT LESSONS: Tuesday evenings, 7.00 pm to 8.00 pm. Six-week courses cost £48. Beginners are very welcome, and all equipment is provided.

AQUA AEROBICS: Wednesday and Friday at 10.00 am. £5 per class, or free for members of the Leisure Centre's Gold Card scheme.

PLEASE NOTE: The pool will be closed on the first Monday of each month for cleaning. All swimmers must wear a swimming cap. Caps can be purchased at reception for £2.50.

paragraphs.label: C
paragraphs.text:
WELCOME TO SUNRISE: Our friendly studio offers yoga for all ages and levels. Whether you are completely new to yoga or have been practising for years, we have a class for you.

BEGINNERS: Mondays and Thursdays at 6.30 pm. A gentle introduction to the basic positions. Please bring a mat; if you do not have one, you may hire one for £1.

FLOW: Tuesdays at 7.30 pm and Saturdays at 9.00 am. A faster class for those with some experience.

RELAXATION: Fridays at 5.30 pm. A calm, slow class with breathing exercises, ideal for relieving stress after a hard week.

PRICES: A single class is £9. A pass for ten classes costs £70 and is valid for three months. The first class is free for new customers.

BOOKING: Classes are small, with a maximum of fifteen people, so booking in advance is essential. Please arrive five minutes early, as latecomers cannot be admitted once the class has begun. Cancellations must be made at least 12 hours before the class, or you will be charged in full.
